cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

mechanism: A copies a practical warming habit without understanding it and laces affectionate help with old waiting resentment.
confusable: D93 must remain warm, not simply punish or demand apology.
comparison: Birthday care versus warmth after taxi wait.
seedUse: Keep B foot-warming request turning into particular pointed tenderness.
